description.value: Leq'a:mel Convenience is a convenience store serving the Leq'á:mel First Nation community on the Lougheed Highway corridor near Deroche, BC. It is listed as an official venue on the First Nation's website, indicating it forms part of the community's local services infrastructure. Touring cyclists riding the Lougheed Highway through the Fraser Valley may find it a useful stop in an area with limited commercial services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as a convenience store (shop=convenience) on the Lougheed Highway near Deroche, BC, operated within the Leq'á:mel First Nation community. The website at leqamel.ca/venue/convenience-store/ is an events-venue listing page that confirms the store's existence and gives its address as '41350 Lougheed Hwy Deroche, BC V0M 1G0', which conflicts with the OSM value of '43101;3101 Lougheed Highway' (the latter appears to be a malformed dual-number entry). The venue page contains no amenity or product details, so all amenity fields must remain null.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists '43101;3101 Lougheed Highway' (likely a malformed dual-number OSM entry) while the website venue page lists '41350 Lougheed Hwy Deroche BC V0M 1G0'; website address used.
No phone number specific to the convenience store is available; the general First Nation administration number (604) 826-7976 is for the band office, not the store.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real convenience store listed on the Leq'á:mel First Nation's official website with no evidence of closure; a legitimate stop for cyclists on the Lougheed Highway.
